calculate_minimum_flips: calculate the minimum flips required to make a binary matrix symmetric using f_gold
compute_matrix_transpose: compute the transpose of a square matrix by swapping rows and columns
count_mismatched_elements: count mismatched elements between a matrix and its transpose to determine flip count
run_symmetry_test: run the test suite comparing f_filled output against f_gold for multiple matrix inputs
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that calculates minimum flips for matrix symmetry
